title: Inhabitation and selection of margin-retaining exchange-stable Ds states
statement: Rerouted and audit-hardened by DS17. On every atomless scalar (L)-law satisfying (M1)+(M4), almost surely all sufficiently large samples have no ordinary one-point exchange-stable labeling satisfying fixed (M2)+(M3)+(M5); this is a theorem, independent of measured funnel scans. Remaining on-class questions are the (M5)-free empirical tracking of coincident-centroid wasted-cell configurations and attainment/one-sided continuity of v*(kappa) versus v*+(kappa). The Gaussian sign-split construction proves only that the closed population feasible class is nonempty for kappa <= 1/pi. Margin-constrained methods produce constrained-stable, priced, non-inductive outputs rather than DS14-certified ordinary-stable rules. The live non-centered root-to-empirical transfer moves to OPEN-DS-MARGINS-NONCENTERED; mix3 is measured motivation, not theorem authority.

proof_location.section: OP30. Inhabitation and selection of margin-retaining stable states

warning: The (M5)-free population classification does not supply empirical stable sequences, and the measured mix3 gate root supplies neither uniqueness nor sufficiency.
